resources.string: ARC-DNA grid and cube, light or dark with the system. Lock screen: rainbow glitter around fingerprint and camera, rave circles on the beat.

ARC-DNA Scroll: scrolls the apps you choose in the launcher (Mediathek → Kopf-Scroll pro App) by nodding or looking up and down. The front camera is read on the phone only; nothing is recorded or sent. A small pill shows the state; tap it to pause.
